feeds.title: Life of Dr. Mom Blog
feeds.description: Life of Dr. Mom is designed for the modern mom who struggles with balancing family, work, and fun. With her experience working in women's health, postnatal care, mental health, and Pediatrics. Dr. Mom works to educate the modern mom with the most relevant up-to-date medical evidence to support families and the healthy development of their children.

feeds.title: Sarah Remmer
feeds.description: My name is Sarah Remmer, and I'm a registered dietitian and mom of 3, and the proud founder and President of The Centre for Family Nutrition, a nutrition counseling practice that specializes in prenatal, infant, and child nutrition. On my blog, I share helpful, reliable nutrition education for busy parents.

feeds.title: Cari Frame Blog
feeds.description: My name is Cari and I am a Self-Kindness Coach. Through our work together, my clients build a deeper, more fulfilling relationship with themselves. Get some insights from my blog posts and make that first step to your happier self.

feeds.title: Girl in a Boy House
feeds.description: I'm Nicole, and I think that the ordinary can be extraordinary, and this blog reflects that. I live in Calgary, with my husband, two sons, and my aging-but-still-here dog Barkley. I write about my life and share recipes. Its all about putting the OM in OMG

feeds.title: Super Urdu Mom
feeds.description: I'm Tamania, a Pakistani-Canadian blogger, influencer, and content creator living in Calgary, Canada, I share the everyday adventures of a Canadian-Pakistani family passing on the love of culture and Urdu to the next generation! My blog covers parenting, multiculturalism, recipes, lifestyle, travel, and resources to pass on cultural values to children in engaging ways.

feeds.title: Calgary Playground Review
feeds.description: My name is Dana I started Calgary Playground Reviews in 2010 which seeks out the best playgrounds, attractions, ice cream shops, and more in Calgary, Alberta, and beyond! I'm an experiential playground expert and mom to three kids.

feeds.title: Food Mamma Blog
feeds.description: My name is Fareen Jadavji Jessa, I'm the founder of Food Mamma. I have a love of food, making it, eating it, photographing it, and watching it get made. This blog celebrates my favorite things - family, food, and travel.

feeds.title: Brittney Bietz Photography Blog
feeds.description: Brittney Bietz has been photographing newborns & children for 9 years now and she loves what she does. She documents her experience with growing families that she works with. Drown in her experiences as you read through her blog.

feeds.title: Made by Momma News
feeds.description: Providing wholesome nourishment and nurturing care to mothers and young children facing situations of adversity and crisis.

feeds.title: Adrianna Adventures Blog
feeds.description: Adventure blog helping you get outside with babies and kids for a hike. Travel and adventure with us through the Canadian Rockies and beyond!

feeds.title: TinyFeats Blog
feeds.description: TinyFeats is committed to providing top-quality toys that kids can't wait to get their hands on. We take pride in offering fair trade, and flexible work to local stay-at-home moms because we understand that having young kids at home can take up a lot of time and money. Discover for yourself why both moms and kids love our toys.

feeds.title: Pursuing Pretty
feeds.description: Kristin Davies is a fashion, beauty, and travel blogger who knows that style does not have to come with a hefty price tag. Her blog, Pursuing Pretty, teaches fashion-stumped women how to shop for polished new outfits and how to discover their own feminine personal style.

feeds.title: The Aspiring Something Blog
feeds.description: The adventures of a girl aspiring to be many somethings, including (but not limited to) a pretty good wife, a passable mom, a decent human being, and a humor blogger whose posts you want to read. She has always found humor to be the best way to approach the challenges of life, and that's how she tries to write each of the entries in her blog.

feeds.title: Calgary Birth Essentials
feeds.description: We help parents prepare for their new baby

feeds.title: Bakersbeans
feeds.description: Welcome to Bakersbeans, the place where Wanda experiments and has fun with food and recipes. Cooking should be easy and not complicated right?! We like to make easy, delicious-tasting, and sometimes quick recipes for our busy family. We also like to revisit vintage recipes and test out new ones until perfect. Lifestyle and brand features fit naturally with our blog's vision.

feeds.title: Family Adventures in the Canadian Rockies
feeds.description: I am the mom of an active teenager and have not slowed down! This blog seeks to chronicle the joys and challenges of taking kids hiking, camping, backpacking, skiing, biking, paddling, and all-out exploring in the Canadian Rockies.
